subject: Post-demo: NovaCare model-fit benchmarks, JSON schema checks, and next steps
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@novacare.ai>, Tom Ranso <tom.r@novacare.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: NovaCare model-fit benchmarks, JSON schema checks, and next steps

Hi Emma / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

Key takeaways from call:
- Primary goal: extract structured clinical insights from intake forms and route to appropriate care team. Low latency on short transcripts is critical (95th pctile < 120ms).
- Success metrics: JSON schema compliance (exact field names + enums), precision on entity extraction >= 92% on our seed prompt set, and no more than 2% functional-call failures at production traffic.
- Data concerns: PII redaction is required before any logs leave NovaCare VPC.

What Redwood validated (quick summary of our quick bench run):
- We ran a 3-model comparison on a 2k-row seed set (attached CSV): Llama2-70B (q4f16), Mistral-8x (fp16), and RW-Instruct-13B (int8-opt). RW-Instruct-13B matched intent/slot F1 the best for your short-form intake (91.7% F1) with the lowest tail latency under our continuous-batching config.
- JSON schema compliance (we ran schema validator v2 against sample outputs): RW-Instruct-13B produced 97% valid JSON by strict schema, Mistral-8x 89%, Llama2-70B 74%.

Immediate next steps (proposed):
1) Provide your canonical JSON schema for intake (if you already have it, please share). If not, we've attached a recommended example (jsonschema_example_v2.json) we prepared based on today's session.
2) Share a 1k anonymized seed prompt set (we can accept pseudonymized CSV) so we can run a longer eval and produce a gold-standard comparison and a per-field regression sensitivity analysis.
3) Redwood will run a 48-hour benchmark (accuracy + latency + function-call reliability) and share a report (SLA-relevant metrics: 95th/99th latencies, token costs, and retry rates).
4) Mutual Action Plan draft attached; suggest we align on scope + procurement timing next week.

Questions for you before we kick off:
- Do you have a required JSON schema version or naming conventions?
- Is there a preferred secure upload (S3 with role, or SharePoint)?
- Any constraints on model families (we flagged no closed-source-only policy during the call)?

Deliverables we commit to after you share the seed set: 48h benchmark report, a recommended config for batching + KV cache, and a small eval harness (prompt + expected JSON examples) you can run on-prem for Private deployment.

I'll follow up with the action owners for each step. Thanks — appreciate the time.

Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: novacare_benchmark_results.csv (summary), jsonschema_example_v2.json (recommended schema), mutual_action_plan_novacare.pdf (draft)
From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@novacare.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ranso <tom.r@novacare.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:14:23 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: NovaCare model-fit benchmarks, JSON schema checks, and next steps

Thanks Sergio — this is helpful. A couple quick answers: 

- We'll attach the canonical schema later today; it's versioned internally (schema v3.1). Your example looks close, but our enums are stricter (we validated common payer codes).
- Secure upload: S3 with a temporary role is preferred. I'll ask infra to create the bucket and share a role.
- Model family constraints: procurement prefers open models or source-available variants; we'll need a short compliance note for any RW-branded variants (for procurement).

We can provide a 1k anonymized seed set by Monday; will that timing work for your benchmark window? Also want to confirm how Redwood evaluates function-calling failures — is that retried automatically or surfaced as an error in the report?

—Emma
Emma Liu
Product Lead, NovaCare Health
emma.liu@novacare.ai

On Thu, Mar 11, 2027 at 08:26 AM Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 13 Mar 2027 11:02:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: NovaCare model-fit benchmarks, JSON schema checks, and next steps

Sergio — thanks, forwarding a short ops checklist for the bench run: 

Ops checklist (internal):
- Intake: request temporary S3 role from client; ensure objects are encrypted with KMS.
- PII handling: run our scrubbing pipeline (local runbook) prior to any data leaving their VPC; get customer sign-off.
- Model selection for formal run: 1) RW-Instruct-13B (int8-opt), 2) Mistral-8x (fp16), 3) Llama2-13B (q4f16) — note: swapping Llama2-70B -> 13B to reduce cost and still capture capacity variance.
- JSON schema validator: use schema v2 strict mode and also run relaxed pass to enumerate minor mapping differences.
- Function-call testing: simulate high concurrency and inject 5% synthetic malformed responses to measure retry behavior. Default retry policy: 2 retries with backoff; log all failures to the evaluation trace.

I'll own the benchmark run and produce the per-field regression matrix. Lauren — can you prepare the cost sketch and an estimated timeline?

Karthik
Sr. Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@novacare.ai>, Tom Ranso <tom.r@novacare.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 08:31:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: NovaCare model-fit benchmarks, JSON schema checks, and next steps

Hi Emma — quick scheduling + what we'll hand off once you share the seed set: 

Schedule:
- Monday (Mar 15): NovaCare shares S3 role + 1k anonymized seed set.
- Tue-Wed (Mar 16-17): Redwood runs 48-hour benchmark and function-call reliability tests.
- Thu (Mar 18) 10:00 AM PT: 30-min walkthrough of the benchmark report and recommended config.

What you'll receive after the run (deliverables):
- Full benchmark HTML report (latency percentiles, token cost breakdown, per-model F1 by field). Link will be shared S3/Drive.
- JSON schema regression matrix: fields with mapping errors, enum mismatches, and recommendations to resolve (we'll include quick patch prompts).
- Prompt set + gold labels (for your eval harness) and a CI-friendly set of unit tests we suggest for quality regression detection.
- A short note for procurement that summarizes model licensing implications and the suggested deployment mode (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) with recommended cost/latency tradeoffs.

On retries and function-calling: by default our bench harness will attempt 2 retries on malformed/invalid JSON responses, with exponential backoff. We'll report the raw failure rate and the post-retry success rate separately so you can see how much the retries mask underlying model instability. If procurement needs zero-retry failure SLAs we can include an operational plan (caching, deterministic prompts, and fallback model variants).

Action items for NovaCare:
- Share schema v3.1 or confirm you'll use our attached jsonschema_example_v2.json as a starting point.
- Create S3 bucket/role or confirm SharePoint; prefer S3 for speed of bench.
- Tell us if any fields are considered "blocking" (must be exact) vs "best-effort" — we'll prioritize exact-match fields in the regression alerts.

I'll get Lauren to send the cost sketch and calendar invite for the Thurs walkthrough. Looking forward to it.

Sergio

Thanks — confirmed: we'll share S3 role and 1k anonymized rows by EOD Monday. Schema v3.1 attached in that upload (it's the canonical one).

Two quick notes:
1) A couple of fields are blocking (payer_code, member_id). Please call these out explicitly in the regression matrix.
2) Procurement wants the brief licensing note by Wed EOD if possible. If you can flag RW-Instruct-13B as a recommended candidate with a short paragraph on licensing, that helps.

We'll await your calendar invite for Thu 10:00 AM PT.

Emma
